_comment: DUNGEON RUN events. Design rule: BOTH options must cost something. An event where one choice is strictly better is not an event, it is a free reward. Skill-based minigames are high risk, high reward - they can make or break a run, which is the point.
designRules: Every event choice has a real downside.
The player can always walk away, but walking away is itself a cost (time, gold, or a missed relic).
Minigames must be winnable with skill, not luck alone. The player should feel they lost because they played badly.
Minigames must be fast. 60 seconds maximum. If it drags, it is cut.
_runBuffsComment: Lasting effects an event can grant (grantRunBuff). 'fights' is how many fights it lasts; 'atFightStart' uses the same keywords as cards.

free_skeleton_3_fights.name: Grave Company
free_skeleton_3_fights.text: Your next 3 fights start with a free Skeleton already summoned.

events.name: The Chained Prisoner
events.flavor: He has been here longer than the chains. He begs. The begging is not quite in a language you know.

choices.label: Free him
choices.text: He joins you as a companion. But the chains were holding something IN him.

choices.label: Take his gold and leave
choices.text: He had a great deal of it. He will not need it.

events.name: The Dealer's Table
events.flavor: A dead man sits at a table with cards laid face down. His hand still moves. He wants to play.

rules.description: 12 cards face down, 6 pairs. Flip two at a time to find matches. You get a limited number of flips.
rules._tuning: 16 flips is beatable with real attention and unwinnable by guessing. Lower it to make the game harder.

entry.label: Sit down and play
entry.text: Costs 8 HP to sit. The dead do not play for free.

outcomes.text: He nods and pushes something across the table.
Close enough. He gives you part of the pot.
He takes the rest of what you bet.

walkAway.label: Do not sit down
walkAway.text: Nothing gained. Nothing lost. He watches you go.

events.name: The Blood Wager
events.flavor: A basin, a blade, and three relics on a shelf behind it. The basin does not care whose blood it is.

rules.description: Each round, pay HP to draw. Draw good and the prize improves. Draw the Rot and you lose everything you have staked. Stop at any time and keep what you have won.
rules._tuning: The expected value turns negative at round 4. A player who does the math stops at 3. A player who wants the rare relic gambles anyway. That tension IS the event.

walkAway.label: Leave the basin alone
walkAway.text: The relics stay on the shelf.

events.name: A Loose Page
events.flavor: A single page from your book, torn out long before you owned it, pinned to the wall with a nail.

choices.label: Read it
choices.text: Add a random RARE card to your deck. Reading it costs you something you do not get back.

choices.label: Burn it
choices.text: Remove any one card from your deck permanently. Heal 15.

events.name: The Mass Grave
events.flavor: The dungeon has been running a long time. This is where the arithmetic of it ends up.

choices.label: Raise them
choices.text: Start your next 3 fights with a free Skeleton already summoned. The dungeon notices what you did.

choices.label: Bury them properly
choices.text: Heal to full. It takes hours you do not have - skip the next reward.

events.name: The Ancient Tree
events.flavor: Its roots have split the floor and its branches the ceiling. It was here before the dungeon. It is listening.

choices.label: Offer 100 gold
choices.text: Press the gold into its bark. It gives something back.

choices.label: Kill it
choices.text: Take its Tree Soul. It curses you as it dies.

choices.label: Take some of it with you
choices.text: Add a Bound Wood Sapling to your deck. Nurture it at a rest site and it grows into a Bound Wood Creature.
